cards.title: Say elevator

Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.

articulation.label: elevator
articulation.alt: elevator: /ɛ/ → /l/ → /ə/ → /v/ → /eɪ/ → /t/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/v/: Upper teeth touch the lower lip; add voice.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
